subject: English
question_text: Write a summary of the passage in no more than 90 to 100 words.
guide_solution: The greatest dramatist after Shakespeare, George Bernard Shaw was born in Dublin. He was from a middle class family. For earning livelihood, Shaw first worked as a Juinor clerk for a Dublin state agent. He was determined to be a writer. Shaw's first novel is 'Immaturity'. He got Nobel Prize for literature in 1925.
